picks.title: AI learning app Gizmo levels up with 13M users and a $22M investment
picks.why_it_matters: A $22M Series A with 13M users signals strong investor appetite for AI-native edtech and validates consumer traction as a fundable thesis in the space.

picks.title: Hightouch reaches $100M ARR fueled by marketing tools powered by AI
picks.why_it_matters: Growing $70M ARR in 20 months via AI agents shows the velocity possible when layering AI onto existing data infrastructure—a playbook early-stage founders can replicate.

picks.title: This energy startup's bet on 100-year-old grid tech is paying off
